title: Petra and the Ghost
author: Mirabel Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Sandoval, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
